name: Execution contract
domain_vision: What executable work may a runtime accept without inventing business or query meaning?
core_invariants: A work unit references an immutable executable artifact and exact entry point.
Unknown effect or execution guarantee is a compiler gap.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Executable artifact and kernel dispatch
domain_vision: Which immutable artifact, ABI, target and compute-kernel entry point can be loaded and invoked?
core_invariants: Artifact identity includes bytes digest, ABI and target.
A compute kernel is never confused with an operating-system kernel.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Process runtime
domain_vision: How is an isolated process created, signalled, waited for and terminated?
core_invariants: A reused numeric PID is not the same process identity.
Exit status and termination cause are retained separately.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Thread runtime
domain_vision: How are address-space-sharing execution agents created, joined, synchronized and scheduled?
core_invariants: Thread identity is scoped to its process lifetime.
Join, detach and cancellation semantics are explicit.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Asynchronous task runtime
domain_vision: How are cooperatively scheduled futures/tasks polled, awakened, cancelled and drained?
core_invariants: Dropping a future is not assumed to cancel its external effects.
Blocking operations require an explicit blocking boundary.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Actor runtime
domain_vision: How does an identity-bearing isolated actor serialize messages, supervise failures and recover state?
core_invariants: Actor restart identity and state-recovery policy are explicit.
Mailbox ordering is scoped, not called globally ordered.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Executor and worker pool
domain_vision: How is runnable work assigned to reusable workers and execution slots?
core_invariants: A worker is an execution occurrence, not a unit of requested CPU.
Draining forbids new assignments while preserving declared completion policy.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Heterogeneous device runtime
domain_vision: How are CPU, GPU and accelerator devices discovered, selected, addressed and commanded?
core_invariants: Device discovery and provider selection are separate.
Memory accessibility and synchronization are explicit per context.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Distributed task and collective runtime
domain_vision: How are work and data coordinated across failure-prone execution members?
core_invariants: Membership edition is part of collective identity.
Remote failure is not represented as a local exception alone.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Job, work-unit and attempt control
domain_vision: What is the authoritative lifecycle of declared work, retries and individual attempts?
core_invariants: Retry creates a new AttemptId and never rewrites the previous attempt.
Success, failure, cancellation, timeout and preemption remain distinct outcomes.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Cancellation, deadlines and timeouts
domain_vision: How can execution be requested to stop, and what is known when its deadline or timeout expires?
core_invariants: Cancellation request is not completion.
Deadline, elapsed timeout and observed wall-clock time are separate.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Flow control and backpressure
domain_vision: How is finite downstream demand signalled and overload propagated without unbounded queues?
core_invariants: Unbounded buffering is refused unless explicitly waived.
Dropped, rejected, delayed and cancelled work are distinct.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Checkpoint, resume and replay
domain_vision: What execution state can be durably captured and safely resumed after interruption?
core_invariants: A checkpoint is bound to artifact, state schema and runtime compatibility.
Restore creates a new attempt even if logical work identity is preserved.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Resource identity, capability and topology
domain_vision: What resources exist, what can they do, and how are locality and failure relations represented?
core_invariants: Resource identity is not inferred from a mutable name.
Topology edges carry relation kind, validity and evidence.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Workload resource demand
domain_vision: What finite resource quantities, qualities and topology relations does work require?
core_invariants: Every blocking resource dimension is bounded or explicitly rejected as unbounded.
Minimum, target and maximum are not interchangeable.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Allocatable resource offer
domain_vision: What time-bounded capacity and guarantees may an allocator truthfully offer?
core_invariants: Offer validity and evidence freshness are explicit.
An offer is not an allocation and makes no usage claim.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Resource pool and inventory
domain_vision: Which offers form a pool, and what capacity is free, held, allocated, unavailable or stale?
core_invariants: Pool totals reconcile with held, allocated, unavailable and free capacity within measurement error.
Stale inventory is never silently treated as free.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Quota, finite budget and precharge
domain_vision: What authority limits resource admission and spend before effects occur?
core_invariants: Quota availability does not prove physical feasibility.
Effectful work consuming a hard budget is admitted only after atomic precharge or equivalent reservation.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Workload admission
domain_vision: May this work enter contention given policy, authority, feasibility and finite budgets?
core_invariants: Admitted does not mean scheduled or running.
Every refusal has a stable typed reason and evidence.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Reservation and allocation
domain_vision: How is capacity held, committed, assigned and released without double allocation?
core_invariants: Capacity is deducted exactly once at reservation commit.
Expired holds cannot be committed without a new reservation.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Leases, heartbeats and fencing
domain_vision: How is temporary authority kept alive and stale holders prevented from acting?
core_invariants: A stale lease holder cannot pass a monotonic fencing check.
Heartbeat receipt is evidence of observation, not proof of useful progress.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Placement constraints and assignment
domain_vision: Where may an admitted work unit execute given hard constraints, preferences and topology?
core_invariants: Hard constraints are never traded for score.
Assignment is versioned against inventory and demand editions.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Scheduling policy
domain_vision: In what order and by which declared objective should eligible work receive feasible assignments?
core_invariants: Policy, mechanism and observed decision are separate records.
A heuristic result never claims optimality without a bound or proof.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Priority, eviction and preemption
domain_vision: When may running or reserved work be displaced, and what compensation is required?
core_invariants: Preemption is not reported as application failure.
Victim selection preserves protected-class and disruption constraints.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Autoscaling and elasticity
domain_vision: When and how may replicas, allocations or provider capacity change in response to demand?
core_invariants: Scale recommendation, requested capacity and realized capacity are distinct.
Every loop declares delay, hysteresis and maximum rate of change.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Capacity and feasibility planning
domain_vision: Can forecast demand be served within topology, SLO, cost, energy and failure constraints?
core_invariants: Forecast uncertainty is retained.
Aggregate free capacity does not prove a feasible placement.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Failure domains, partitions and failover
domain_vision: Which correlated failures can occur and which degraded or failover behaviors are permitted?
core_invariants: Redundancy claims name the failure domain they tolerate.
Partition, crash, omission, corruption and operator action remain distinct.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Resource pressure and health
domain_vision: What current evidence indicates saturation, degradation, unavailability or device health?
core_invariants: Health is time-scoped observation, not a permanent resource attribute.
Pressure and utilization are not interchangeable.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Usage accounting, cost and charge
domain_vision: What was allocated and consumed, at what rate, by whom, and at what monetary cost?
core_invariants: Requested, reserved, allocated, metered and billed quantities never collapse into one field.
Corrections preserve the original charge lineage.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Energy, power and carbon accounting
domain_vision: What power, energy and carbon quantities are attributable to resource use and scheduling choices?
core_invariants: Power, energy and carbon are dimensionally distinct.
Estimated attribution names its model and uncertainty.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Runtime SLO and error budget
domain_vision: Which service-level objectives constrain execution and how is compliance evaluated?
core_invariants: An SLO names population, indicator, threshold and evaluation window.
Missing telemetry cannot be silently interpreted as success.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Runtime observability
domain_vision: Which signals identify an observed runtime entity and explain execution and resource behavior?
core_invariants: Telemetry producer and observed entity are distinct.
Sampling, aggregation and dropped-signal loss are explicit.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Execution and resource receipts
domain_vision: What append-only evidence proves what the control plane requested and the runtime observed?
core_invariants: Receipts are append-only and content-addressed.
A receipt proves only its issuer, scope, observation time and stated claim.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Execution target profile
domain_vision: Which runtime, ABI, isolation, architecture and resource mechanisms can a target support?
core_invariants: Target profile is versioned and evidence-backed.
Target compatibility is not inferred from architecture name alone.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Isolation and virtualization runtime
domain_vision: Which process, container, VM or sandbox boundary constrains effects and resource access?
core_invariants: Isolation mechanism never implies a threat-model guarantee by name alone.
Resource isolation and security isolation are evaluated separately.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Provider resource and deployment occurrence
domain_vision: Which concrete provider-owned resource exists now, under what authority, edition and lifecycle?
core_invariants: A provider SKU, a purchased entitlement and a deployed occurrence are different identities.
Occurrence state is reconciled from provider evidence.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Runtime control-plane reconciliation
domain_vision: How is declared runtime state continuously compared with observed state and safely converged?
core_invariants: Reconciliation is generation- and fencing-aware.
Repeated failure converges to a typed degraded or refused state, never infinite invisible retry.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.

name: Runtime control-plane product boundary
domain_vision: Which user outcome may package runtime contexts without becoming their semantic owner?
core_invariants: A control-plane product packages contexts and libraries but owns no borrowed semantic type.
Provider and library replacement seams are part of the product contract.
gaps: Aggregate ownership and two-implementation conformance remain to be adjudicated.
